svg.title: Web app on Azure
svg.desc:
Web app on Azure A public site behind Front Door, with the app and its data inside one virtual network. Solid lines: requests and data.
Blocks, left to right: - Public entry (Azure Front Door) - App secrets (Azure Key Vault) - Web app (Azure App Service) - Uploaded files (Azure Blob Storage) - Orders database (Azure SQL Database) - Session cache (Azure Cache for Redis) Groups: - App subnet: Web app - Data subnet: Orders database, Session cache - Virtual network: Web app, Orders database, Session cache - Resource group: Public entry, Web app, Orders database, Session cache, App secrets, Uploaded files Lines: - Public entry -> Web app, labeled "HTTPS" - Web app -> Orders database, labeled "SQL" - Web app -> Session cache, labeled "sessions" - Web app -> App secrets, labeled "secrets" - Web app -> Uploaded files, labeled "files" Note: Fictional workload. No deployed resources Replace the labels; keep each service name under its icon
